subject: Urgent: sandbox lifeline request — expired trial needs brief reactivation
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@quantixa.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@quantixa.ai
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request for short-term sandbox credits — trial expired

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the time today — the team has been making solid progress integrating Redwood's API. We ran into a bit of a timing issue: our sandbox trial hit the expiration boundary this morning and the environment is locked. We have one outstanding integration smoke test and a customer demo scheduled for Monday, May 3.

Is there any way to get a short, temporary top-up (two weeks) or a small reactivation of the sandbox so we can finish the final verification and run the demo with production-like prompts? We only need roughly 10k tokens worth of headroom to complete the tests.

I attached a usage export (quantixa_usage_apr24.csv) so you can see what burned through the remaining credits — happy to share any other details. We really want to show the latency/cost numbers live in the demo.

If there's a simple approval flow we can fill out or a PO you need, let me know and I can loop in procurement immediately. Appreciate any fast help here.

Best,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Platform Integrations
Quantixa, Inc.

Attachment: quantixa_usage_apr24.csv
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@quantixa.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for short-term sandbox credits — trial expired

Thanks for the note and the CSV, Elena — good context.

Short answer: yes, we can put together a brief lifeline to cover your demo. I'll escalate internally to get a brief, time-limited credit grant in place. For transparency, our usual approach for trial reactivations is a 2-week extension with a fixed token allocation (we can offer 10k tokens as an initial bridge).

Next steps on our side:
- Jordan (sales manager) — can you approve a two-week 10k token bridge for Quantixa?
- Grace (ops) — if approved, can you apply the credit and confirm the exact expiry and any invoice/PO record we should attach?

Elena — if you can confirm the exact scope of what you need (approx token count and whether the demo will use embeddings/streaming/generation), I can include that in the request so ops applies the right profile. Also please share the procurement contact if one is required.

I'll also attach a short internal memo I prepared that summarizes the POC value and proposed credit amount.

Thanks — aiming to have this sorted within the day so your team can resume testing.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MVP_evaluation.md
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for short-term sandbox credits — trial expired

Marking approved on a conditional basis.

Approval details:
- Grant a two-week sandbox reactivation for Quantixa (Quantixa, Inc.), effective immediately upon ops action.
- Token allowance: 10,000 tokens (applied as a temporary credit).
- No reactivation fee for this one-off (given demo deadline and strong signal of purchase intent).
- Requirement: Quantixa to complete the short procurement acknowledgement form and provide a PO number within 7 days of credit application. If PO is not provided, credits will be rescinded.

Grace — please apply the credit and set expiry to 2027-05-10T23:59:59Z. Also attach a reactivation_notice.pdf to the account record and log the HubSpot activity (link below).

Marcus — please confirm with Elena that the timeline works and capture the procurement contact.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@quantixa.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for short-term sandbox credits — trial expired

Hi Elena — looping back with confirmation. Per Jordan's approval we've applied a temporary credit to Quantixa's sandbox. Details below: 

- Credit applied: 10,000 tokens (temporary grant)
- Effective: 2027-04-28T09:12:00Z
- Expiry: 2027-05-10T23:59:59Z
- Conditions: Please submit PO/acknowledgement to ops@redwood.ai within 7 days. Failure to provide PO will result in rescind of the temporary credit.

I've also attached a short reactivation_notice.pdf and a stub invoice (invoice_stub_#QTX-0612.pdf) for your records. The HubSpot activity has been logged: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/QTX-2027-0612.

If there's any problem gaining access on your side after 10–15 minutes, reply here and we'll take another look in the infra console. Good luck on the demo — happy to extend a short monitor window if you run into unexpected token spikes.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: reactivation_notice.pdf; invoice_stub_#QTX-0612.pdf
